title: On the leading and penultimate leading coefficients for NRS(2) applied to a cubic polynomial
summary: We prove that the leading and penultimate leading coefficients in $u_3$ of the ``error" terms of NRS(2) applied to a cubic polynomial $f(z) =\sum_{i=0}^3 a_i z^i=\prod_{i=1}^3 (1-u_iz)$ with starting point $(-\frac{a_1}{a_2}, -\frac{a_1}{a_2})$ are positive-coefficient polynomials in $u_1$ and $u_2$. Our proof for the leading coefficients simplifies that of \cite{DeFranco} and extends to the penultimate leading coefficients as well.
